subject: Request: Pilot extension due to SDK/gateway integration delay
messages:
From: Sophie Chen <sophie@gatewaylabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Team <dev-team@gatewaylabs.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — integration delay on our side

Hi Lukas,

Quick update from our end: our engineering lead discovered an unexpected behavior in the API gateway adaptor when calling Redwood's streaming endpoint. We blocked a sprint yesterday to investigate and it looks like we'll need at least another two weeks to get the adapter stable — the issue is intermittent and affects auth token refresh handling when we ramp parallel streams.

We really like the performance and want to finish the pilot, but the integration lag means we won't be able to complete the workload evaluation inside the current sandbox window. Can you advise if Redwood can extend the pilot window and/or top up sandbox credits so we can finish the end-to-end tests once the devs unblock?

I've attached a short trace file and included our dev team on the thread. If useful we can do a short call tomorrow to walk through the logs.

Thanks,
Sophie Chen
Director of Product
Gateway Labs

Attachments: gateway-integration-trace.txt (log snippet, text, 18KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@gatewaylabs.com>
Cc: Dev Team <dev-team@gatewaylabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — integration delay on our side

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for sending the trace. I had a quick look and it matches a race condition our SDK team saw last quarter; we've got a known mitigation we can recommend for token refresh + parallel streams.

In the meantime, absolutely understand the need for runway. Two things I can do quickly:
- Approve a 14-day extension to your sandbox access immediately so your QA can finish full-load runs.
- Provide a one-time sandbox credit top-up (equivalent to 200k tokens) to cover the additional tests.

Before I lock that in I want to loop in Marissa from Customer Success to confirm the credits and make sure the billing/deal plan stays aligned. Would an initial 14-day extension plus the credit bump work while your engineers apply the fix? If you want a longer window we can escalate to Ben for approval.

If youd like, we can do a 30-minute triage with our SDK engineer tomorrow at 11am PT.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

---
On Thu, Sep 10, 2026 at 10:14 AM Sophie Chen <sophie@gatewaylabs.com> wrote:
> Hi Lukas,
> 
> Quick update from our end: our engineering lead discovered an unexpected behavior...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — integration delay on our side

Lukas — thanks for the callout. 200k token top-up + 14-day sandbox extension seems reasonable for Gateway Labs given stage of deal (POC with production intent). Approving internally for CS to provision.

Couple of notes:
- Confirmed the customer is on the standard pilot plan and hasn't received previous extensions in last 6 months.
- I'll attach the credit in the sandbox and flag the usage to the finance/billing team to avoid auto-charge surprises.

If Sophies team needs more than 200k tokens (we can monitor), we can revisit after the triage call. If Ben prefers to sign off on anything beyond the one-time credit, loop him here.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

[internal: gateway-integration-trace.txt saved to the deal folder]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — integration delay on our side

Thumbs up from me for the 14-day extension + 200k token top-up. If the triage shows a deeper architectural change on their side we should consider offering an additional 2-week extension (no extra credits) while they implement — but let's wait for the SDK sync first.

Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@gatewaylabs.com>
Cc: Dev Team <dev-team@gatewaylabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — integration delay on our side

Hi Sophie — quick update and next steps:

1) We have approved a 14-day sandbox extension for Gateway Labs (active immediately).
2) We've provisioned a one-time 200,000 token sandbox credit to your pilot account; Marissa will monitor usage and reach out if we see abnormal patterns.
3) Were on for the SDK triage call tomorrow at 11am PT — Lukas (me) and our SDK engineer Priya will join; please share any additional logs beforehand if possible.

If the triage reveals you need more runway, well handle it case-by-case; for now Ben has signed off on the above approvals.

Thanks for the partnership — were excited to help you finish the evaluation.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposal-v2.pdf (pilot terms, PDF, 230KB)
